report:
Source assessment: both ordinary implementation associations and all 11 ordinary associated tests account for the complete correspondence claim; no TODO/N/A entries or deferred prerequisites exist. CorrespondenceIndex::validate enumerates crate/module namespaces, type/class declarations and explicit methods, requires nonempty Rust site sets, and checks every site for containing package ownership, existing modeled target and compatible namespace/type/operation kind. workspace::document_namespace and crate_source_owner supply the modeled namespace from its nearest crate. Cargo metadata supplies package identity and target roots, while source traversal records multiple sites and cfg conditions without evaluating them. Module markers remain nonexecutable. The explicit SymbolDefinitions adapter inventories supported generator declarations; arbitrary macro token trees are excluded.
Test assessment: maps_independently_named_rust_declarations_and_checks_both_directions exercises successful independent naming, method identity and crate markers. module_headers_require_correspondence_in_addition_to_the_crate_header asserts both valid module correspondence and a missing module diagnostic. deletion_dangling_targets_wrong_crates_and_wrong_kinds_fail checks missing, dangling, foreign, incompatible and malformed annotations. markers_are_source_coverage_not_executable_coverage asserts acceptance, nonexecutability and failed executable lookup. multiple_cfg_sites_preserve_conditions_without_claiming_active_build_coverage asserts two sites and retained positive/negative conditions. cargo_owner_covers_both_library_and_binary_and_explicit_nested_module_paths asserts package-normalized identities, custom library/binary targets and explicit nested paths. known_symbol_generator_is_parsed_but_arbitrary_macro_tokens_are_not_anchors asserts supported generated entries and absent arbitrary-token entry; known_generator_accepts_unconditional_mapping_and_unrelated_cfg_attr asserts accepted unconditional mappings and retained cfg. generated_declarations_reject_hidden_or_misspelled_correspondences checks all four generator positions with diagnostic text and exact spans. conditional_mappings_cannot_silently_pass_reverse_validation and annotations_on_unsupported_nodes_cannot_silently_disappear assert rejected hidden, nested conditional, unsupported and misspelled annotations while allowing unrelated cfg_attr. These assertions would detect omitted reverse checks, invented macro coverage or executable module markers. Captured the complete test file to include index/model/VALID setup helpers.
Baseline and execution: independently compared current bytes of both implementation files and the complete test file with /tmp/sage-pre-fragment-validations/meta.contracts.correspondence/input.json; all three match exactly. Reassessed the supplied historical rationale against current claim, association metadata, implementation behavior and complete associated assertions; it remains sufficient. Personally ran review start/read and byte comparisons; no behavioral tests or workspace build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator reports 321 passing sage-meta tests and a passing root build, separately supplied execution evidence. No source changes or requested edits.
